run_singlepoint_calculations: run singlepoint energy and force calculations on a batch of atomic structures using an ASE calculator
calculate_properties_for_atoms: calculate energy, forces, or other properties for a subset of structures split across parallel jobs
write_results_to_json: write singlepoint calculation results as a compressed JSON file to a specified output directory
normalize_properties_by_natoms: normalize calculated properties by number of atoms or a custom key from atoms.info dictionary
save_target_properties: save target properties from atoms.info alongside calculated results for comparison and analysis
